# Segmentation Remedy 2 — public decoder pretraining plus DP fine-tuning

Preregistered 2026-09-19, before any v5 pretraining or scored cell. David authorized this additional route after Remedy 1 failed. V3 and v4 evidence, failures, and the per-site population boundary remain unchanged. No thesis edits, tags, promotion, or replacement of the earlier negative result. Registration remains vetted=FALSE. The v4 confirmation may continue concurrently on pod2.

This protocol incorporates the preserved `protocol-v4.md` (including its v3 contract) for all definitions not explicitly replaced here. The preregistration record pins both files, every campaign executable and verifier, provenance, schemas, and the grid by SHA256. A changed grid or training contract requires a new protocol; there are no outcome-dependent amendments or automatic retries.

## Public stage, explicitly outside privacy accounting

Use BUSI, Kaggle mirror `aryashah2k/breast-ultrasound-images-dataset`, version 1 (2021-03-14). Dataset URL: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/aryashah2k/breast-ultrasound-images-dataset . Versioned download: https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/aryashah2k/breast-ultrasound-images-dataset?datasetVersionNumber=1 . The exact downloaded ZIP has 204,421,470 bytes and SHA256 `7fffc86a517934da55021f66641d81383058d26a30adb0ffab3780ca7e52d57d`. No publisher MD5 is supplied by this mirror. The official Cairo URL had a certificate-chain failure during preparation; Zenodo requests timed out. This mirror is explicitly identified, not represented as an original-author download.

The mirror declares **CC0: Public Domain**. Preserve the metadata response and CC0 1.0 legal text at https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode.txt with hashes in `provenance/busi-v1/provenance.json`. This records the mirror's declaration, not an assertion that the mirror authors own all original rights. Original attribution is retained: Al-Dhabyani W, Gomaa M, Khaled H, Fahmy A. *Dataset of breast ultrasound images*. Data in Brief. 2020;28:104863. DOI https://doi.org/10.1016/j.dib.2019.104863 . Mirror attribution: Arya Shah, Kaggle, version 1. Original dataset page: https://scholar.cu.edu.eg/?q=afahmy/pages/dataset . No dataset/checkpoint tensors are redistributed in the package.

The fixed census is 780 images: 437 benign, 210 malignant, 133 normal. Use every image in lexicographic relative-path order; union every matching `_mask*.png` annotation. No outcome-dependent deletion or deduplication. BUSI does not supply the patient mapping required here for patient-level evaluation; it is used only as public image-level pretraining, with no BUSI privacy or held-out utility claim. There is no BUSI validation/test selection. Duplicates within BUSI are retained and this limitation is reported. Dataset identity is based on release provenance; no claim of cross-dataset near-duplicate screening is made.

Retain the original archive. Convert mode-1 masks and identical binary RGB/RGBA silhouettes to L-mode {0,255}, ignoring alpha as a class; reject ambiguous channels/vocabulary. Record every original and normalized mask hash and every image hash. Normal images explicitly declare empty masks; a nonempty normal mask is invalid. Use the unchanged runtime pair loader, bilinear 128-grid image transform, ImageNet normalization, nearest mask resize, packed validity, and fixed zero tensors for invalid images/pairings. Retain invalid examples in minibatch denominators and record their census.

Encoder is the unchanged frozen `resnet18_layer2_128_v1` public ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1 backbone, checkpoint SHA256 `f37072fd47e89c5e827621c5baffa7500819f7896bbacec160b1a16c560e07ec`. Verify its hash, eval/no_grad state, and unchanged parameters/BatchNorm. No encoder fine-tuning, augmentation, mixed precision, or TF32. Only the existing v4 **narrow 9,521-parameter decoder** is trained. Public loss is the unchanged per-image 0.5 BCE + 0.5 soft-Dice loss, smoothing 1, validity weighted.

For each seed 20260919/20260920/20260921 initialize the decoder with the corresponding v4 Torch seed, then train one nonprivate 60-epoch path on BUSI only. Save immutable checkpoints after epochs **20 and 60**; the 20-epoch candidate is the prefix, not a separately restarted run. Public minibatch 16, shuffled without replacement each epoch, keeping the final partial batch. Permutation seed is the big-endian integer of the first 8 SHA256 bytes of `busi-v5-order|<seed>|<epoch>`, used with NumPy default_rng. Adam lr=0.001, betas=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, no decay/AMSGrad; optimizer continuous during public pretraining. No early stopping or model selection on public training loss. Hash input tensors, decoder tensors, archive, audit and every checkpoint. The public-pretraining process accepts only the BUSI archive/provenance/output and the backbone; **no BUS-BRA image, mask, tensor, split, or score is read by that process**.

## Frozen development and fine-tuning grid

Eight candidates: public-pretraining epochs {20,60} × DP logical batch {16,64} × rounds {10,20}. Narrow decoder and frozen encoder are fixed. Each candidate runs all three original seeds: **24 real three-site federated-DP development cells**. The same seed-specific checkpoint is reused across its batch/round candidates and all confirmation twins, never retrained after development. Pretraining is an additional disclosed data stage, not a zero-cost random initializer or a DP release.

Use exactly the v4 inner splits: preserve original site membership, order training subjects by SHA256(`inner-v4|<seed>|<subject-id>`), reserve floor(site N/5), retain the rest, and exclude original outer test subjects from development. Hash all three inner manifests before public pretraining or any scoring. BUS-BRA inner sites remain 228 subjects each; confirmation restores the original 284/site.

Fine-tuning changes **only decoder initialization** relative to the corresponding v4 narrow candidate. Three local epochs each round; Adam 0.001 with identical defaults/reset per round; equal-site FedAvg. No frozen decoder layers, encoder training, physical microbatching, clipping change, private-validation service, sampler change, or altered accounting. Development epsilon=8; confirmation epsilon grid {1,4,8}, delta=1e-5, clip=1, replace-one patient adjacency. Preserve exact Poisson L=ceil(N/batch), q=1/L, divisor=max(1,floor(N/L)), every empty draw, cryptographic sampling/noise, sticky semantic seeds and full 3×rounds×L horizon. Site and pooled mechanisms use their own exact N/q/sigma/horizons. Independent PRV recomputation is mandatory. Public pretraining consumes no DP budget; repeated BUS-BRA benchmark runs are separately recorded and must not be portrayed as one non-composed private release.

Selection is the highest arithmetic mean **foreground-positive** federated-DP inner-validation Dice across all three seeds, then fewer parameters, fewer total logical site updates, fewer pretraining epochs, decoder name, then batch. Every eligible candidate must have three verified releases, exact public initialization, source/tensor checks, cleanup, and all node-round accounting transcripts. Retain failures with no invented scores or retry. No eligible candidate means study FAIL. A numerical inner floor failure does not stop confirmation. Only BUS-BRA inner validation selects; there is no pooled screening or outer-test selection.

## Confirmation, twins and floor

After deterministic selection, run the unchanged **66-cell confirmation matrix**, 33 cells in each original batch arm. Preserve BrEaST/BUS-BRA primary cells, epsilon {1,4,8}, all seeds, BUS-BRA small192, BCE-only and heterogeneous extensions. Selected rounds/pretraining checkpoint apply throughout; selected batch is primary and the other is a prespecified sensitivity arm, never a second selection. Preserve all cohorts/splits. This is public benchmark confirmation on previously inspected outer splits, not an unseen clinical test.

Every pooled nonprivate, pooled DP, federated nonprivate and federated DP branch begins from the exact same seed-specific public-pretrained arrays. Bind archive/audit/checkpoint/encoder/protocol/seed hashes to each cell before federation. The public benchmark server must replace **both** its live decoder and the transmitted Flower ArrayRecord; capture those actual arrays. The evidence verifier compares captured arrays byte-for-byte to the selected checkpoint. Existing twin checks retain loss, tensors/validity, optimizer resets, schedule, inference, artifact checksums and independently recomputed pooled/site accounting. Public initialization is outside the trusted runner; the installed privacy runtime is unchanged.

Fixed threshold 0.5; same canonical-grid Dice/IoU and empty conventions. Report all-subject, foreground-positive and empty-reference strata plus all four original trivial masks. For primary BUS-BRA epsilon8, require the across-three-seed **foreground-positive Dice ≥0.50 and ≥ the mean per-split strongest foreground-positive trivial Dice +0.10**. Also preserve the v4 all-subject requirement **Dice ≥0.50 and ≥ mean per-split strongest all-subject trivial Dice +0.10**. Both gates must pass; neither criterion is weakened. Report each batch separately. Keep all four envelope checks, SD and df=2 t intervals as in v4.

The terminal report writes an explicit primary and sensitivity **PASS/FAIL** with the component means. Missing/invalid epsilon8 evidence is FAIL to establish utility, with numerical floor null/undetermined, never a fabricated numerical failure. Report incomplete lower-epsilon/extension evidence independently. A passed numerical floor does not resolve envelope flags, validate the full study, promote the model, or replace the v4 negative boundary.

## Execution and evidence gates

Use `/workspace/segmentation/v5`, a separate `/workspace/segmentation/campaign-v5` tooling snapshot and `/workspace/logs/segmentation-v5-*.log` on pod2. Reuse only the pinned v3/v4 prepared data/features/runtime. Do not modify running v4 files, stop its driver, or bypass the two shared federation slots. One v5 worker allows a concurrent v4 federation. No new pod is needed.

Before development scoring, retain all seven existing mechanism gates and execute a fresh three-node/two-round synthetic integration for **each public checkpoint epoch** (seed 20260919). Each gate requires six unique actual node-round captures, independent accounting, retained invalids/source census, checkpoint initialization identity, exact reload predictions and cleanup. Scored 10-/20-round cells require all 30/60 node-round captures, not just six. Gate failure stops v5 before scoring and remains recorded. Synthetic fixture activity is not a public utility score.

The supervisor runs public pretraining → synthetic gates → development → selection → 66-cell confirmation → schema-checked evidence assembly and terminal `STATUS_R2.md`, `summary-v5.json`, and `artifact-checksums.json`. It catches individual development/confirmation failures to finish the planned matrix; no attempt overwrites an existing one. Final evidence carries the public-pretraining stage, runtime/commit/tool pins, initialization identity, unchanged privacy contract, site diagnostics, retained v3/v4 evidence and all failures. The launch receipt records protocol/registration SHA256, exact command, PID and log path. Launch detached with nohup and `< /dev/null`, then exit without polling the study; reviewer monitoring is external to this session.
